_meta.purpose: Frozen tidy extract of per-SitRep operational indicators for the BDBV 2026 outbreak, the substrate for the operational forecasters in lovs/forecast/. Extracted once and committed so a forecast run is reproducible from the repo rather than from a live sibling checkout.
_meta.licensing: CC BY 4.0 (schema and extraction); underlying figures are INSP/INRB SitRep publications.
_meta.reading_note: data_as_of is the DATA day, not the publication day. Clamp any time-since estimator to the last data day: a reporting gap otherwise reads as observed improvement.
